page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.se1ne.6xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance running on the KVM hypervisor. It features an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor with an x86_64 architecture, operating at a base clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The instance is configured with 24 dedicated vCPUs derived from 12 physical cores with Hyper-Threading enabled. It is equipped with 192.0 GB of RAM, providing a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU. No local storage is bundled with this instance, and it does not include any GPU accelerators. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 4 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks indicate a clear division between single-core and multi-core capabilities. Single-core performance is relatively weak, as shown by lower-tier scores in stress-ng and Geekbench single-core tests, alongside poor single-threaded gzip compression speeds. However, multi-core execution scales to average levels, with Geekbench multi-core, Passmark CPU, and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression tests all falling within the middle 50% of benchmarked systems. Memory bandwidth tests for both cached small blocks and uncached large blocks also demonstrate average, stable throughput.

The primary tradeoff of the ecs.se1ne.6xlarge is its modest single-core processing speed combined with a generous memory allocation. This makes it a cost-efficient choice for memory-intensive workloads that do not require ultra-high single-threaded CPU performance. It is well-suited for database operations, in-memory caching systems like Redis, static web serving, and moderate multi-threaded data processing tasks.
